candidate_state: prepared from the validated release candidate; publication pending

halfkp_trainer.factorizer: optional king-independent piece-square rows folded into standard nn.bin export

internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, the optional opening-book feature, documentation and public-contract checks, four PyTorch HalfKP trainer tests, a native material-only USI smoke, WebAssembly native tests, release package generation, and generated JavaScript contract checks passed. The WebAssembly analysis contract now returns only a legal primary PV from the matching completed iteration. Bounded one-shot CSA supervision persists its terminal state. No checkpoint was selected or bundled.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.63.

known_limitations: The in-house HalfKP trainer requires PyTorch and NumPy; its tests skip when those optional Python dependencies are unavailable.
Random per-position validation can leak adjacent positions from the same game; release documentation recommends separately prepared by-game validation input through --val-data.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no playing-strength claim.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
